mapper.select: SELECT A.MST_DATE, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT(DATE, MST_DATE), 23) AS MST_DATE_FORMAT FROM dbo.TWK_MONTH_BASIC A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.MST_DATE) DESC
SELECT A.SCH_GBN, A.GBN_NAME FROM dbo.TWK_SCHEDULE_GBN A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND ISNULL(A.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.ODER_SEQ)
SELECT A.DEPT_CD, A.DEPT_NAME FROM dbo.THR_DEPT A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.MST_DATE AS MST_DATE, A.MST_MONTH AS MST_MONTH, A.MST_NO AS MST_NO, A.TITLE AS TITLE, A.IMPORTANT_YN AS IMPORTANT_YN, A.DESCR AS DESCR, A.SCH_GBN AS SCH_GBN, A.MAIN_DEPT_CD AS MAIN_DEPT_CD FROM dbo.TWK_MONTH_SCHEDULE A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.MST_DATE = #{MST_DATE} AND A.MST_MONTH = #{MST_MONTH} ORDER BY A.SCH_GBN, A.MST_NO
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(A.MST_NO), 10000) AS MST_NO FROM dbo.TWK_MONTH_SCHEDULE A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.MST_DATE = U.MST_DATE AND A.MST_MONTH = U.MST_MONTH

insert.if:
INSERT INTO dbo.TWK_MONTH_SCHEDULE ( OFFICE_CODE, MST_DATE, MST_MONTH, MST_NO, TITLE, IMPORTANT_YN, DESCR, SCH_GBN, MAIN_DEPT_CD, REG_USER, REG_DATE)
SELECT #{row.LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE}, #{row.MST_DATE}, #{row.MST_MONTH}, #{row.MST_NO}, #{row.TITLE}, #{row.IMPORTANT_YN}, #{row.DESCR}, #{row.SCH_GBN}, #{row.MAIN_DEPT_CD}, #{row.LOGINUSER_ID}, #{row.REG_DATE}
